scope: public Veyon Campus help center, first wave
defaultPolicy: Only rewritten, source-reviewed guides are published. Internal implementation, deployment credentials, school data, and unverified procedures are excluded.

sources.applicability: website downloads and current public route copy

sources.path: docs/学生端首次部署与恢复指南.md
sources.public: extract only general safety principles; do not publish old version-specific steps
sources.stale: version-specific UI and cloud status are stale
sources.sensitive: contains internal deployment, cloud, and recovery details

sources.public: rewrite verified user workflow; mark real Veyon operations as field-test pending
sources.sensitive: contains local data path; omit it

sources.path: docs/教师端课堂快捷管控使用指南.md
sources.applicability: current classroom quick control source baseline
sources.public: extract conservative steps and verification limits
sources.stale: some operations require Windows field verification
sources.sensitive: internal version and implementation details; omit them

sources.path: docs/设备健康中心现场验收指南.md
sources.public: do not publish test matrix; rewrite user-safe troubleshooting only
sources.sensitive: contains internal test procedures and diagnostic design

sources.public: rewrite only safe, user-visible recovery steps
sources.stale: Windows uninstall behavior needs field verification
sources.sensitive: service, Agent, scheduled task, registry and policy ownership details; omit internal mechanics

sources.public: exclude; do not expose deployment details
sources.sensitive: service topology, API deployment and environment details
recovery, trust, signing, service and deployment details

sources.stale: design may differ from released behavior

sources.sensitive: fixtures, scripts, environment configuration and deployment setup

sources.stale: historical behavior must not be presented as current
sources.sensitive: may contain machine names, logs, internal paths or test details
sources.replacement: rewrite only after current-source and public-safety review

reviewRule: status=published requires a named source reference, public-safe rewrite, current-source review, and visible note when field behavior has not been verified.
